source: de Wilde, Heijnsdijk & de Ridder (2021), D5.5 - Report on VIV (hydrodynamic) behaviour, FLOTANT deliverable 210430-FLT-WP5_D-5-5_V0, MARIN report 30995-53-DWB, 30 April 2021 (Tables 2-1, 2-2, 3-4, 6-1, 6-2; Secs. 2.3-2.5, 3.4, 4.4, 4.5, 5.3, 5.4, 6.3; Appendices 1-3); Ulveseter, Thorsen, Saevik & Larsen (2019), Applied Ocean Research 90, 101856 (Table 1, Sec. 4.1); Ulveseter, Thorsen, Saevik & Larsen (2018), Marine Structures 60, 241-260 (Table 3); Chaplin, Bearman, Huera Huarte & Pattenden (2005), Journal of Fluids and Structures 21(1), 3-24 (Eq. 4); Facchinetti, de Langre & Biolley (2004), Journal of Fluids and Structures 19(2), 123-140 (Secs. 2-3)
report_doi: none (a public project deliverable, dissemination level PU); the project's CORDIS record lists it under Results; grant agreement 815289, https://doi.org/10.3030/815289
bibliographic_data: the report's title page, document number and authors from the PDF; volumes, issues and pages of the articles from Crossref (api.crossref.org), 2026-11-16
data_used: FEM input tables in air (Sec. 4.5) and in water (Sec. 5.4): 101 nodes, element labels, positions, lumped masses, weights, static tensions, EA, EI, accelerometer stations; RAOs at 5 and 10 mm, 200 kg, surge and sway, in air (Appendix 1, pp. 63-64) and in water (Appendix 2, pp. 67-68); A/D_rms = sigma/OD against Ur of the 40 tow tests at 200 kg, cross-flow (Y) and in line (X), at 1/2L, 3/4L and L (Appendix 3, pp. 70-72); test speeds and directions (Table 6-2); top and bottom tensions (Table 6-1); OD, length, mass (Table 2-1) and wet weight (Table 2-2); the tow-test high-pass of 3.5 rad/s (Table 3-4); f1 = 1.77 Hz for Ur (Sec. 6.3)
extraction: extract_d55.py: the FEM tables from the PDF text; the RAO charts, vector graphics, as plotted coordinates mapped through the tick labels (axis residual at most 1.2e-3 rad/s and 1e-3), series named by the legend marker colour; the Appendix 3 charts, embedded 1386 x 867 raster images, calibrated on the grey grid lines (Ur residual 0.004), markers found by colour (40 points per chart, 39 for Y at L where an edge marker is clipped), each mapped to a tested speed within 0.0085 m/s
identified_structure: from the forced-oscillation RAOs of the same specimen, not from the tow data: cable EI 1650 N m^2 and bending damping Bb 130 N m^2 s from the in-air surge RAOs at 5 and 10 mm (the tables' EI 3000 N m^2 matches the in-air resonance only with MARIN's empirical factor lambda 1.10, Sec. 4.5); in water the link chain and load cell with EI 100 N m^2 and the clump held laterally by K 32.5 kN/m and C 20 N s/m (a cantilever post of 0.3 m from a still anchor), from the surge and sway RAOs over 1.0-3.0 Hz (MARIN's table fixes the clump node and makes the chain rigid)
assumptions: fresh water 1000 kg/m^3 (not stated; Table 2-2's 2.8 kg/m and 9.7 N/m at OD 48 mm imply it); the cable's diameter the OD, the other parts the diameter of the displaced volume of their table weight; the counterweight or clump as an axial spring k_ax 20 kN/m in series with the tables' EA, the unstretched lengths set for the tables' static tensions; uniform current over the whole line; Cd 1.2 and Ca 1 on the cable and the hardware; the clump's drag area 0.05 m^2 (not given); the accelerometers' axes normal to the cable, so the model's displacement takes the gravity term g theta/omega^2 the measurement holds

coefficients.uls19: Ulveseter et al. (2019), Table 1, fitted by them to the NDP riser in uniform flow (Sec. 4.1, Chh 1.5): Cd 1.2, CM 2, Cl 0.85, cF 0.144, dF 0.064; VIV ClX 0.75, alpha 0.15, Chh 1.5; blind here
coefficients.b1: the generic set of the Delta Flume riser case, nothing fitted to these tests: Cl 0.8, cF 0.18, dF 0.08, Cd 1.2; VIV ClX 0.85, alpha 0.15 (Ulveseter et al. 2018, Table 3); VIV AMPLITUDE Cv 0.8 with CdAmp = 1 + 2.3 s + 1.7 s^2, s = (A/D)/sqrt(2), at A/D 0-1.5 (Chaplin et al. 2005, Eq. 4); VIV DAMPING 0 0 1
coefficients.wake: Facchinetti et al. (2004): WAKE OSCILLATOR CL0 0.3, St 0.2, eps 0.3, A 12 (their values from rigid-cylinder lift and lock-in data in the literature), LINE TYPES Cl 0, Cd 1.2; cross-flow only

processing: statistics over t > 20 s of 60 s runs; each station's displacement plus g theta/omega^2, high-passed at 3.5 rad/s, A/D_rms = sigma/OD; Ur = V/(OD f1), f1 1.77 Hz; r.m.s. log errors over the tests with Ur >= 3; release: the first tested Ur above the 1/2L cross-flow peak at which A/D_rms falls below 70 % of the peak; RAOs: harmonic fit over the last 10 s of 5/f + 25 s runs, scored over 1.4-2.0 Hz in air and 1.0-3.0 Hz in water
reproduction: the default command, run into a new work directory with the executable of summary.json, reproduces response_comparison.csv, rao_comparison.csv and summary.json byte for byte

sensitivity.note: tow: A/D_rms at the given speeds [m/s] against response_comparison.csv; rao: r.m.s. log errors against summary.json; end_*: the full uls19 sweep with another lower end
